title: Single Block Supercuspidal Datum
body_html:
Single Block Supercuspidal Datum

Let \(\Sigma=(x,\Gamma,\phi,\rho)\) be a supercuspidal datum for \(G=U(V)\). Write \[ F^0[\Gamma]=\prod_{j\in J}F_j \] and decompose \(V\) according to the field factors. The datum is a single block of positive depth \(r\) if every nonzero component \(\Gamma_j\) has the same negative valuation and \(V\) is the corresponding single summand.

A datum of depth zero is a single block of zero depth when it is represented as \[ (x,\Gamma,1,\rho) \] with \(\Gamma\) central of nonnegative depth. These are the two atomic pieces used in the theta-lift map for general supercuspidal data.
